title: Matt Finucane - Senior Software engineer
description: I am a Berlin based Senior Software Engineer.

content.content: I'm Matt Finucane, a Senior Product and Platform Engineer based in Berlin.
I'm a Senior Product Engineer with 21 years of experience delivering web and mobile applications using modern JavaScript and TypeScript technologies.
I specialise in building scalable, maintainable products with React, React Native and Node.js, and have worked across agencies, startups and international product companies throughout Europe.
This website highlights my experience, selected projects and the technologies I work with today.
